name: 96150 · S Lake Tahoe, CA
findings: ZIP 96150 (S Lake Tahoe) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96150 (S Lake Tahoe) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 96150 (S Lake Tahoe) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
